empty_description: Add concepts from the OHDSI vocabularies, a custom concept, or import an ATLAS expression.
delete_description: They leave the expression of this edit. Nothing is saved until you save the draft.
pick_concept: Click a concept to see its details, hierarchy and relations.
no_vocabulary_description: Searching concepts and optimizing need the OHDSI vocabularies: import them in Settings → Vocabularies.
non_standard_description: Non-standard concepts should not be used directly: prefer the standard concept they map to.

custom.intro: A concept that no OHDSI vocabulary has. It is created in this dictionary's custom vocabulary ({{vocabulary}}), non-standard, with an id above every custom id already used.
custom.id_hint: Allocated above every custom concept id in use.
custom.name: Concept name

import.title: Import an ATLAS expression
import.description: Paste an ATLAS concept set expression (or a whole concept set JSON). Its items are added; concepts already in the expression are skipped.
import.skipped_one: {{count}} skipped (duplicate or without a valid id).
import.skipped_other: {{count}} skipped (duplicates or without a valid id).
import.error_no_items: The JSON must hold a non-empty "items" array.

optimize_description: Removes items already covered by an ancestor with its descendants, then looks for one parent concept that replaces several items, keeping the same resolved concepts.
optimize_optimal: The expression is already optimal: nothing redundant found.
optimize_identical_one: The resolved set ({{count}} concept) is unchanged.
optimize_identical_other: The resolved set ({{count}} concepts) is unchanged.
optimize_mismatch_title: This optimization would change the resolved concepts
optimize_mismatch_description: The vocabulary may lack some mapping rows (the browser keeps only those of the dictionary's concepts). You can still apply it and check the resolved list.
unsaved_resolution_hint_server: Resolved now from the edited expression with the loaded vocabulary. The repository's list follows when the draft is submitted: the server resolves it again and commits it with the set.
unsaved_resolution_hint_static: Resolved now from the edited expression with the vocabulary loaded in this browser. The repository's list (concept_sets_resolved/) must be regenerated and proposed with the set.
resolve_unavailable_title: The edited expression cannot be resolved here
resolve_unavailable_description: Load the OHDSI vocabularies (Settings → Vocabularies) to see what it resolves to. The repository's list shows the saved expression only.
resolve_error: The expression could not be resolved.
resolved_file_ready_one: Resolved here ({{count}} concept). Propose it as a second file: it is copied and {{forge}} opens it.
resolved_file_ready_other: Resolved here ({{count}} concepts). Propose it as a second file: it is copied and {{forge}} opens it.
resolved_file_manual: No vocabulary is loaded to resolve it here: run python3 resolve.py --id {{id}} and propose the regenerated file with the set.
submit_resolved_updated: The resolved list was recomputed by the server and committed with the set.
submit_resolved_stale: The server has no vocabulary loaded: the resolved list was not regenerated and still reflects the previous expression.
submit_proposal_error: The branch is pushed but the forge did not open the proposal: open it from the link above.
